definition: a public square in a town
description: A wide, wet stone plaza in Paris at sunset, with the Eiffel Tower rising straight ahead across the river and the columns of a large building on the right. A cream-coloured classic Porsche 911 stands alone on the empty paving in the foreground while the camera drifts slowly sideways past it. The orange sky is full of cloud, a flock of birds turns above the tower, and a few distant people stand at the far edge of the square.
